skills.name: Demons' Judgement
skills.description: Punishes the demons and attacks enemies. Bad effects on enemies.  *Continuously cancels enemy invincibility (4 sec) *Negates enemies' regen (4 sec) *Enemy ATK -50% (7 sec)

skills.name: Cross Prayer
skills.description: Makes a sacred prayer. Good effects on allies.  *Creates a shield over an area (5 sec) *HP +440% (10 sec) *HP x 50% Area Recovery (per sec) (10 sec)

abilities.name: Resistance: Deployment Freeze
abilities.description: Rangers with this Ability block enemies' Deployment Freeze Ability.

abilities.name: Berserk
abilities.description: Berserk activates and the Ranger gets bigger when the Ranger's HP is reduced to 50% or lower. For 3 sec, immune to status ailments. For 3 sec, unit's HP will not go below 1. For 10 sec, ATK 1000%, ATK speed 100%, and immunity to knockback and Stun. - Berserk activates 1 time only. (Revived units can use it again) - Status ailments exclude Advent gimmicks, Abilities, and item effects.
